translation.name: Jade and Water Seongsu LCDC Branch
translation.summary: A brunch restaurant on the upper floor of LCDC SEOUL with an open interior and views across Seongsu.
translation.description: Jade and Water's Seongsu LCDC branch is a daytime brunch restaurant inside the LCDC cultural complex, with a high-ceilinged dining room and upper-floor setting.
translation.local_tip: It is primarily a daytime venue, so check the current last-order time before planning a late meal.
